_note: This skill's checked-in routing corpus. WHAT IT IS: a LEXICAL-OVERLAP legibility aid, NOT a verdict — routing-eval scores surface token overlap only (see meta-skills/skills/routing-decomposer). Positives span the invocation families (imperative / diagnostic 'is this sound' / symptom 'illegal state can exist' / object-first 'review this data model' / indirect-paraphrase 'make illegal states unrepresentable'); the indirect/paraphrase positives are deliberately low-overlap and the proxy MAY MISS them — that is a measurement limit, not a description defect. Negatives are drawn ADVERSARIALLY from CONFUSABLE in-repo siblings to surface precision collisions: type-decomposer collides hardest with query-decomposer (SQL/DDL — type also accepts SQL DDL as a target) and extraction-decomposer — NOTE EXPLICITLY: type AND extraction BOTH involve JSON Schema (type runs legal/illegal instance sets against a schema; extraction runs schema-check against an extraction), so a bare 'JSON Schema' request is a real collision and both fences must hold. type also brushes code-decomposer (a unit of code that USES the type) and arch-system (system boundaries). Re-derive when the neighbourhood changes.
